q: How do we count the varnish and polish used on wooden products?
title: Wood varnish and polish: Scope 3
short: Varnish, lacquer and polish you buy are Scope 3 Category 1, by litres or kilograms bought and a supplier or database factor. Solvent that evaporates in your shop is not counted as CO2 in Scope 1 unless it is burnt, for example in a fume incinerator.

ul: Litres of varnish, lacquer and thinner bought.
Factor per litre or kg, with source.

p: Fumes are an air quality issue. If an incinerator burns them, its fuel and the solvent carbon become Scope 1.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
